description: Boundaries of villages (desa/kelurahan) and districts (kecamatan), one GeoJSON file per regency and level, simplified to about 11 m with shared borders kept together; keyed by the Kemendagri codes of the wilayah set.
status: partial: regencies listed in `regencies`; others are added on demand (F-035)
source: Badan Informasi Geospasial, Basis Data Batas Wilayah Administrasi Edisi Juni 2026 (metadata date 2026-06-15), layer BATAS_DESAKEL_AR of https://geoservices.big.go.id/rbi/rest/services/BATASWILAYAH/BATAS_DESAKEL_AR; full-precision download kept in sources/batas-wilayah/; servers fetch full precision themselves with the presisi command (F-035)
licence: Informasi Geospasial Dasar, open by law (UU 4/2011 Pasal 12 huruf e and Pasal 42); credit "Sumber: Badan Informasi Geospasial" (F-035)
procedure: tools/converters/batas-wilayah.py fetch <raw_dir> <regency...>, then build <raw_dir> data/wilayah/wilayah.json.gz data/batas-wilayah --tolerance=11
crs: WGS 84 (EPSG:4326), RFC 7946: outer rings counter-clockwise, holes clockwise

files.kecamatan/<regency>.geojson.gz: one Feature per district, the union of its villages

desa.name: official name from wilayah
desa.status: boundary status as BIG writes it: Batas Definitif, Hasil Kesepakatan or Batas Indikatif
desa.basis: regulation the boundary rests on, as BIG writes it (null when none)
desa.area_km2: area of the full-precision polygon on the WGS 84 ellipsoid

kecamatan.name: official name from wilayah
kecamatan.villages: number of villages with a polygon
kecamatan.area_km2: sum of the villages' full-precision areas

notes: Only 'Batas Definitif' rests on a signed regulation. 'Hasil Kesepakatan' is agreed by the villages and checked by BIG; 'Batas Indikatif' is a working line. UU 4/2011 Pasal 16 ayat (2): show boundaries that are not definitive with a different line style or colour, and never present any of them as a legal boundary.
Use for maps, filters and 'which village is this point in' hints; let users correct the village they chose. Credit: Sumber: Badan Informasi Geospasial.
District areas equal BIG's own district layer (BATAS_KECAMATAN_AR) to four decimals.
